name: llm-setup
description: For Claude Code, Python 3, Git and Node.js (with npm): when one is missing it asks before installing, then runs the install op — the plain command first, and an agent (with one retry) when that did not get there. First-run setup settles an LLM source BEFORE this wizard runs (`flow llm set auto`); without one the plain commands still install, and only the agent fallback cannot run.
